explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/395: Erdős's original version with 1 in place of √2 is false (Carnielli–Carolino). With z_1 = 1, z_k = i and n even, the imaginary part is a sum of an odd number of ±1, so |Σ| ≥ √2 > 1 and the count is 0. The statement negates the existence of a uniform c > 0. Faithful.
